narrative.overview:
Warp is the design, weft is the build, and the cloth exists only where both cross. Every page is set on an indigo warp field: a deep blue ground striped with fine vertical threads at a fixed 6px pitch. The work arrives as weft. Each project is a horizontal brocade band whose woven strip carries the client's own colour, and how tightly that strip is beaten says how much weight the project carries. Long-form reading moves onto undyed cotton, a warm off-white with a faint 4px cross weave, so the case study reads as cloth rather than paper.

The system is dense and saturated on indigo, quiet and generous on cotton. One display family (Bricolage Grotesque) does all the talking, heavy and tightly tracked for headings and plain for reading. The name on the home page is not set in a font at all: it is woven as 5x7 brocade lettering, with the warp passing over every float. A single 2px marigold thread runs the length of the home page, from the portrait through every band to a knot in the contact close.

Absence is drawn on purpose. A project with screens and no write-up shows bare warp, loose threads with one started pick, and says "Screens only". An empty grid cell shows warp instead of a hole. Motion is vertical packing only: picks slide down and pack tight as a band enters view. With reduced motion, everything renders already beaten.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo warp field owns the ground; undyed cotton appears only under long-form reading.
Projects are brocade bands; pick density encodes rank.
One integer density scale (pick-0 to pick-3) drives rank, the active state, and the beat-in.
One continuous marigold weft thread ties the home page together.
Missing content is drawn as bare warp, never left blank and never faked.
Motion packs vertically and nothing else moves.

rules.name: The Warp Owns the Ground Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the page. Cotton is laid down only where someone reads long text (case-study body, the About background panel). Short pages, galleries, and the 404 stay on indigo.

rules.name: The Two Hands Rule
rules.body: Marigold acts on indigo; cochineal acts on cotton. They do not swap surfaces.

rules.name: The Client Weft Rule
rules.body: A band's strip colour is the client's colour, lifted to OKLCH L ≥ 0.72 and C ≥ 0.08 on indigo. It never becomes a large fill.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and meta are sentence case at normal tracking. No all-caps tracked-out labels anywhere.

rules.name: The Woven Name Rule
rules.body: Brocade lettering is reserved for the name. Decorative only: the real text sits beside it for assistive tech.

rules.name: The One Running Thread Rule
rules.body: On home, a single 2px marigold thread starts at the portrait. On phones it drops from the portrait's bottom-left corner down the selvage; on desktop it leaves the portrait's bottom edge and runs along the hero's foot to the gutter. From there it runs down the left edge of the work column, enters each band at its strip, and ties into the close with a 10px marigold knot above the contact heading. The Work index carries the same left thread. Add no second thread.

rules.name: The Re-count, Never Stretch Rule
rules.body: Woven patterns are tiled at fixed pixel pitch. Responsive change adds or removes threads; it never scales them.

rules.name: The Warp-Over Rule
rules.body: When an image or float needs to sit in the cloth, interlace warp across its edge rather than adding a border or shadow. At the portrait the interlace is its own layer outside the clipped photo frame, in the field's own thread colour (indigo-700): 3px threads come down out of the field to the photo edge, odd threads pass over and run about 24px into the photo, even threads stop at the edge so they read as passing under. The bottom edge mirrors the top, kept short on phones (16px of field, 10px over the photo).

dos: **Do** set every page on the indigo warp field and lay cotton only under long-form reading.
**Do** encode rank and active state with the pick scale (4, 6, 9, 22px): flagship at pick-0, other bands at pick-1, loose state at pick-3, active tabs as 2px picks on a 4px pitch.
**Do** draw absence: bare warp with a single started pick, labelled "Screens only", instead of an empty slot or a placeholder.
**Do** use marigold for actions and focus on indigo and cochineal for actions and active states on cotton.
**Do** weave each band in the client's own colour, lifted to OKLCH L ≥ 0.72, C ≥ 0.08.
**Do** tile woven patterns at fixed pixel pitch so threads re-count across viewports.
**Do** render everything already beaten under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
donts: **Don't** use the monochrome name-plus-photo-plus-card-grid portfolio layout; projects are bands, not cards.
**Don't** move anything on any axis but vertical packing; no slides, fades-in from the side, parallax, or scale-ins beyond the 2% screenshot hover.
**Don't** add a second running thread or break the one that exists.
**Don't** use brocade lettering for anything but the name.
**Don't** copy community textile motifs; the world borrows loom structure only.
**Don't** invent metrics, logos, or endorsements to fill a panel; leave the warp bare.
**Don't** use all-caps tracked labels; meta and labels stay sentence case.
